versioning.rule: Inside v1 fields and URLs are only added, never renamed or removed. Readers ignore unknown fields. A breaking change goes to /v2/, served beside /v1/ until every game has moved.

urls.missingFile: 404, never an SPA fallback page with status 200

id.reservedNote: "off" is the kit's silent choice and the saved value for silence; loadKeyboardCatalog drops a row with that id. No set and no default may use a reserved id.
rules: A published id never changes: player saves store it. Renaming changes name only.
A retired id is never used again.

paths.relativeTo: /v1/keys/ (the catalogue's folder) for profiles[].manifest and profiles[].preview; the set folder for set-1 files[].file and preview
paths.note: The kit resolver refuses an empty path, a leading /, any of forbiddenCharacters and any . or .. segment. The exporter is stricter: every segment must match segmentPattern, so there are no empty segments and no upper case.

fingerprint.name: fp12

seed.appliesTo: set folders written by typing-feel/tools/import-staging.mjs (seed r1, phase G1)
seed.rule: First 12 hex of sha256 over the canonical JSON of the folder's set-1 manifest without its name (schema, id, licence, recipe, files, preview) plus "audio": [ { "bytes": <size>, "file": <name>, "sha256": <hex> } ], every audio file of the folder (key-NN, space-NN, preview) sorted by name.
seed.rename: The name is left out, so a rename alone keeps the folder and its URL: the folder's set manifest keeps the name it was written with and the catalogue carries the new one. Any other change (audio bytes, durations, licence, recipe, file list) gives a new fp12, so a new folder under a new revision.
seed.canonicalJson: Object keys sorted at every level, JSON.stringify with 2-space indent, then a trailing newline (the same serialization as admin/media-assets-v2.mjs hashJson).
seed.why: A Media V2 reference component needs a runtimeUrl that would contain the fp12 itself, so the seed cannot use the Media V2 contentFingerprint.

admin.appliesTo: set folders written by an Admin Publish (phase G6 onward)
admin.rule: First 12 hex of the Media V2 version contentFingerprint (admin/media-assets-v2.mjs versionFingerprint).
admin.keepSeedPaths: G6 import-staging records each seed folder path on its Media V2 version and keeps it, so the first Publish does not move any URL.

fingerprint.neverOverwrite: A set folder is immutable. If sets/<id>/<fp12>/ exists, every audio file must match byte for byte (sha256) and the set manifest must match byte for byte apart from its name; any other difference is an error, never a rewrite.

labels.legacy-218: One of the 32 sets of ticket 218 (keys-firefly/218 builder, scored by its 218 metric), kept by the owner on 30/10/2026 (decision 6). The Admin library can hide or retire each one.

recipes.natural-v1: Owner pick 30/10/2026: each tap kept to the next one, at most 450 ms, no EQ, levels evened 60% (TYPING_FEEL_SERVICE.md §3.9). The only recipe the Admin Format step offers.
recipes.firefly-218: The ticket 218 builder (tools/audio-lab keys/firefly_v2*.py). Import only, never offered by Format.

catalogue.supersetOf: typing-keys-firefly/catalogue-2: today's kit loadKeyboardCatalog reads it unchanged

fields.revision: Id of the published revision; the seed is "r1".
fields.publishedAt: ISO 8601 UTC without milliseconds. Kept as is when a rerun changes nothing.
fields.default: Id of the default set: must be in profiles, published, not provisional.
fields.effects: Typing effect defaults, see effects.defaults below; a game uses them only while its save has no value.

fields.family: Family name (the kit shows it as the group heading).
fields.order: Sorted by family order, then set order; contiguous from 0, so each family is one run.
fields.score: Number or null, as in the staging catalogue (the ticket 218 machine score, not an owner score).
fields.ownerPick: true for a set the owner picked by ear.
fields.labels: Optional list of label ids from labels (added in v1, additive).
fields.note: Optional free text (owner picks keep their pick note).

profile.hiddenAndRetired: Hidden and retired sets are left out of the catalogue. None today.

fields.name: Name when the folder was written; the catalogue name wins after a rename.
fields.files: Keys by number, then spaces by number. The kit keyboardFiles takes every key-NN / space-NN string.

set.note: Measurements stay in the Admin report.json, never in the game copy.
set.size: The 4 KB budget (TYPING_FEEL_SERVICE.md §8.4) is the transfer size: the feel host gzips application/json (nginx gzip on, Cloudflare later). The 72-80-key legacy-218 sets are 4.4-5.2 KB raw and under 1 KB gzip; the owner picks are about 2 KB raw.

fields.build: Before the code step: "data-" plus the first 12 hex of sha256 of the keys-manifest.json bytes. From the code step on: the module build id.
fields.builtAt: ISO 8601 UTC without milliseconds; kept when a rerun changes nothing.

effects.defaultsNote: The games' current defaults (Last Line FX_DEFAULTS, Dragonhold, Wordwoven and Monkeytype at full key volume); each game converts volume to its own scale.
